policy.scope: TS caller policy only; public backend has single-job sampleTime and no count/interval API

limits: Plain native subrip/srt with held-file origin verified against normalized playback; zero/origin2 equivalence and unreliable metadata tail tested, not arbitrary timestamp discontinuities or subtitle platforms.
Five-frame burst/stop is caller TS policy over immutable snapshot; backend single-image sampleTime is separately observed.
Real encoder PID before requested cancel, child gone and no final/temp output; no claim of every validation/publish race.
Independent finite frame/cue/style/digest/cmap comparisons, not exclusive libass font-provider/physical screen or audio proof.
